title: Describe the event, get the floor plan
status: draft 2026-11-18 (studio test), waiting for Abi's approval

slides.headline: Describe it. *Get the plan.*
slides.body: One sentence becomes a floor plan you can edit. Three steps.

slides.headline: Say it the way *you'd brief your team.*
slides.body: Guest count, table shape, stage, dance floor, DJ booth. One sentence is enough.
slides.callout: 200 guests · round tables of 10 · stage · DJ

slides.headline: The assistant *does the first layout.*
slides.body: The AI assistant lays out the plan from your brief, so you start from a draft, not a blank page.

slides.headline: Move anything. *It stays to scale.*
slides.body: Drag tables, resize the stage and check your totals. Work in metres with snap-to-grid.

slides.headline: Try it on *your next brief.*
slides.body: Early access is open. Sign up at eventspacepro.com and plan your next event to scale.
slides.note: Built in Lagos for event professionals.
